description.en: Open-source DeepSeek Harness plugin for the literature loop: search, curate, read with anchors, ask grounded questions, frame hypotheses, draft a paper outline.
description.zh: 开源的 DeepSeek Harness 科研工作台插件：检索、精选、带着页码精读、有锚点问答、选题、草稿写作，一条龙跑通文献工作流。

description.en: Search arXiv / Europe PMC / OpenAlex without an API key, keep a reading library, pull full text, ask questions answered only from that text, write multi-perspective reviews, derive falsifiable hypotheses, run sandboxed verification snippets and export the whole library.
description.zh: 免密钥检索 arXiv / Europe PMC / OpenAlex，维护阅读文献库并拉取全文，只用全文回答问题并逐条核验引文，写多视角综述与研究缺口，从文献库推出可证伪选题，在沙箱里跑验证脚本，最后整库导出。
